title: Dashboard SMTP Quick Action Permission Consistency

items.action: open SMTP settings from the Dashboard quick actions

migration.reason: The existing fair_crm.email_accounts.read permission is reused.

backend.reason: Existing backend email account authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contracts change; only Dashboard SMTP navigation visibility is aligned with the existing route permission.

tenant_isolation.reason: No backend query or organization-scoping behavior changes.

audit.reason: No mutation or audit behavior changes.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: The target email accounts route already requires fair_crm.email_accounts.read; this change aligns the originating Dashboard action.

notes: Dashboard is available without a Fair CRM RBAC permission, but its SMTP Settings quick action previously rendered for every authenticated organization user. The target /admin/email-accounts route already requires fair_crm.email_accounts.read. The action now fails closed and is only offered when that read permission is granted.
